This is a draft, so it only shows up when you preview locally and on Vercel preview deploys. It never reaches the live site. Copy this folder to start a new post, then delete it once your first real post is up.

## Plain prose

Most posts can be nothing more than Markdown. Write paragraphs, add [links](https://quarto.org), and use *emphasis* or **bold** like you would anywhere else.

> Pull quotes come out like this.

## Code you just want to show

```r
library(dplyr)

rides |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(miles = sum(distance))
```

## A live chart

Observable cells run in the reader's browser, so they need no R or Python at build time.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
rides = [
  {month: "May", miles: 310}, {month: "Jun", miles: 420},
  {month: "Jul", miles: 515}, {month: "Aug", miles: 470},
  {month: "Sep", miles: 380}, {month: "Oct", miles: 290}
]
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 50,
  y: {label: "Miles", grid: true},
  x: {label: null, domain: rides.map(d => d.month)},
  marks: [Plot.barY(rides, {x: "month", y: "miles", fill: "#a53620"}), Plot.ruleY([0])]
})
```

R and Python chunks (`{r}` and `{python}`) also work. They run when you render on your own machine, and the results are saved in `_freeze/` so the site build never has to run them.
